result.success: Selection replaced · press Cmd/Ctrl+Z to undo

error.no_speech: No speech detected. Say how to change the selection (e.g. 'make it shorter') and try again.
error.permission_capture: Can't read the selection — grant Accessibility permission so OpenTypeless can read and replace selected text, then try again.
error.no_selection: No text selected. Select the text you want to edit first, then try again.
error.too_long: Selection is too long. Shorten it (max 1000 words / 6000 characters) and try again.
error.llm_disabled: Edit Selection needs the AI model. Turn on polishing and set an API key in Settings.
error.llm_failed: The AI model couldn't process the edit. Nothing was changed — please try again.
error.no_edit: Couldn't recognise an edit instruction. Try again and say how to change the text (e.g. 'make it shorter').
error.no_result: The model returned no result. Nothing was changed.
error.focus_changed: Focus moved to '{{app}}', so nothing was replaced. The result is on the clipboard — switch back and paste.
error.permission_replace: Accessibility permission is required to replace the selection. The result is on the clipboard — paste it manually.
error.selection_lost: The selection was lost or changed before it could be replaced. The result is on the clipboard — reselect and paste.
error.readonly: '{{app}}' didn't accept the replacement (the field may be read-only). The result is on the clipboard — paste it where you can edit.
error.paste_failed: Couldn't paste into '{{app}}' (this may be a permission issue). The result is on the clipboard — paste it manually.
error.generic: Edit Selection failed. Nothing was replaced.

settings.title: Settings
settings.clickToConfirm: Click again to confirm, or press another combination
settings.translateHotkeyDesc: Press this hotkey anytime to toggle translation on/off. A toast confirms the new state.
settings.agentHotkeyDesc: Press to start a forced Hermes-agent recording — the whole transcript becomes the prompt (no "hermes" / "agent" trigger word required). Result is shown in the agent panel.
settings.editSelectionHotkeyDesc: Select text in any editable field, press to start, speak an instruction ("make it shorter", "fix typos", "translate to English"), then press again. The result replaces your selection in-place. If focus moved, permission is missing, or the paste fails, nothing is replaced and the result is copied to the clipboard instead.
settings.mouseTriggerDesc: Map middle-click gestures to actions. Takes effect globally.
settings.autoPauseMedia: Pause local media on record start
settings.autoPauseMediaHint: Pauses Music / Spotify / Podcasts / QuickTime / VLC / IINA when recording begins so the audio doesn't bleed into the mic. Apps without AppleScript support (e.g. QQ Music, browser tabs) are not affected.
settings.agentNotificationHint: Shows a native macOS notification with the start of the response — useful when the agent panel surfaces behind your active app.
settings.sttSignInHint: Sign in and subscribe to Pro to use official STT quota (10h/month).
settings.sttUpgradeHint: Upgrade to Pro for millisecond STT — 10h/month, 99 languages. No API key needed.
settings.sttProActive: Pro active — millisecond STT, 99 languages. No API key needed.
settings.llmSignInHint: Sign in and subscribe to Pro to use official LLM quota (~5M tokens/month).
settings.llmUpgradeHint: Upgrade to Pro for instant AI rewriting (~5M tokens/month). No API key needed.
settings.llmProActive: Pro active — instant AI rewriting. No API key needed.
settings.storedLocally: Stored locally on your device. Never sent to OpenTypeless servers.
settings.selectedTextContextDesc: When enabled, the selected text in the foreground app will be captured via simulated Ctrl+C and sent to the LLM as context.
settings.aboutDescription: Open-source AI voice input tool. Speak to write — turn your voice into polished text in real time.
settings.agentCommandHint: Leave empty to auto-discover from the preset. Set an absolute path if the binary is not in a standard location.
settings.agentArgsHint: Use literal {prompt} as placeholder for the prompt text. Empty = use preset default.
settings.hermesCwdPlaceholder: Leave empty to use the app current directory
settings.agentRoutingDesc: When a transcript starts with one of these phrases, OpenTypeless sends the command to the configured agent instead of the normal AI polish path. The agent hotkey bypasses this entirely.
settings.micHint: Pick the built-in mic to keep AirPods in high-quality mode while recording (using a Bluetooth mic makes macOS downgrade its audio).
settings.accessibilityRequired: Required to auto-paste transcribed text — System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility → enable OpenTypeless. (Not Automation.)
